location.title: Location
location.intro: Nestled in the heart of Antioquia, just two hours from Medellín, Guatapé is Colombia’s most colorful village — a living canvas of vibrant houses, charming zócalos, and breathtaking lake views. Set on the shores of the Peñol-Guatapé Reservoir and only 10 km from the towering Piedra del Peñol, this picturesque town offers endless adventures, from kayaking and wake surfing to climbing the famous 700 steps for panoramic mountain vistas. After a day of exploring, unwind with authentic Antioquian flavors and tropical cocktails as the sun sets over the water.

story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: It all started at the Digital Nomad Fest in Bulgaria.
story.paragraph2: Maria went there for one reason only – to find another adventurous soul as crazy about traveling the world as she was. Chris, on the other hand, came with a single question: how to be a digital nomad and actually make a living from it?
story.paragraph3: He had no intention of meeting someone. In fact, after a poorly organized speed dating event, Chris was ready to leave… until he noticed the woman who had already caught his eye. One last conversation before heading back to the hotel – and bam, it was a match!
story.paragraph4: From that moment, Maria and Chris have never stopped talking. Even better: in their very first twelve months together, they traveled to 14 countries.
story.paragraph5: What began with one conversation became a life filled with laughter, adventure, and love. And now, we can’t wait to celebrate this next chapter with all of you who mean the world to us.
